title: Tan-Chord Angle Theorem
text:
**Theorem (Alternate Segment Theorem):**
The angle between a tangent to a circle and a chord drawn from the point of tangency is equal to the inscribed angle subtending the same arc on the opposite side of the chord.

title: Apply the Theorem
text:
The angle TAC is between tangent TAB and chord AC.
The angle ABC is in the alternate segment.

By the tan-chord theorem:
$$\angle TAC = \angle ABC = 48°$$
